title: Asymmetric research costs can reverse aggregate responses to a positive merger complement
checked_scope: A two-firm heterogeneous-cost extension of the source's one-state research game, with unique interior Nash and merged outcomes.
significance: Derives the asymmetric equilibrium formulas and a strict-concavity counterexample where increasing a positive cross-firm innovation benefit lowers total merged research.
